programs.title: Sin City
programs.desc: Set in the dark and miserable town Basin City, this film noir follows three different people, all caught up in violent corruption. Stars Josh Hartnett, Mickey Rourke and Jessica Alba.

programs.title: The Furnace
programs.desc: Set in the Western Australian outback during the 1890s. To escape a harsh existence and return home, a young Afghan cameleer falls in with a mysterious bushman on the run with stolen Crown gold.

programs.title: The Movie Show
programs.desc: Margaret Pomeranz talks to director Mark Lewis on Wonderful World of Dogs, while David Stratton interviews Cynda Williams and Joie Lee on Mo' Better Blues.

programs.title: The Movie Show
programs.desc: Reviews of Arachnophobia with Frank Marshall, Akira, Life and Nothing But, Cyrano de Bergerac with Gerard Depardieu, viewers favourite Cinema Paradiso, David & Margaret's pick An Angel at My Table.

programs.title: A Room With A View
programs.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programs.title: Delfin
programs.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin, an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small town outside of Buenos Aires. Delfin's ambition is to join a children's orchestra in a neighbouring village.

programs.title: Iris
programs.desc: The story of the lifelong romance between celebrated novelist Iris Murdoch and her husband John Bayley, from their student days through her battle with Alzheimer's disease. (Kate Winslet).

programs.title: Gosford Park
programs.desc: Set in the 1930s, Robert Altman's film takes place in an English country house where a weekend shooting party is underway. The story centres on the McCordle family, particularly the man of the house.

programs.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programs.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programs.title: The Orator
programs.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status by proving his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community.

programs.title: The Man Who Knew Too Little
programs.desc: Wallace  thinks the intrigue erupting around him is part of an audience-participation theatre event. Yet the world's fate depends on this gullible dummy who can't even spell CIA.

programs.title: The Big Lebowski
programs.desc: A cult classic where 'The Dude' (Jeff Bridges) is mistaken for a millionaire, dragging him and his friends into crime and chaos. A hilarious, unforgettable Coen Brothers comedy.
